title: Clapper on UFO detections at Area 51 in The Age of Disclosure

tellings.quote: James Clapper is on record, you know, in the age of disclosure saying that, you know, we were at Area 51 and we had we were systematically detecting UFOs in that sensitive airspace.

plain: The former US intelligence chief James Clapper says on record that the US was regularly detecting UFOs in the restricted airspace around Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada. Michels cites this from The Age of Disclosure, a documentary in which Clapper appears, and mentions John Brennan along with him. Michels brought it up while debating a well-known skeptic, as proof that top officials take the sightings seriously.
